Dangerous commands such as FLUSHALL / FLUSHDB / KEYS / CONFIG / DEBUG / SHUTDOWN can still be used directly: rename them or set them to empty with rename-command, or forbid application accounts from using them with ACL.

fork 耗时过长会让 Redis 在 RDB / AOF 重写时卡顿：减小实例: A long fork time makes Redis stall during RDB / AOF rewrites: reduce the instance memory, avoid business peak hours, and disable transparent huge pages (THP).
maxmemory 已设置但淘汰策略是 noeviction：内存满后所有写入都: maxmemory is set but the eviction policy is noeviction: once memory is full, all writes will fail; for cache scenarios switch to allkeys-lru / allkeys-lfu, and for database scenarios set up capacity alerts.

从库与主库的复制链路异常：检查网络、主库 repl-backlog-size 与: The replication link between the replica and the primary is abnormal: check the network, the primary's repl-backlog-size and client-output-buffer-limit replica, and resynchronize on the replica if necessary.
使用 volatile-* 淘汰策略时，没有过期时间的 key 不会被淘汰：给缓: With a volatile-* eviction policy, keys without an expiry are never evicted: set an expiry on cache keys, or switch to an allkeys-* policy.
关注 ≥ %d 秒 / 告警 ≥ %d 秒或偏移差 ≥ %s: Watch ≥ %d s / Alert ≥ %d s or offset gap ≥ %s
内存使用率偏高：评估扩容或设置 maxmemory 与合适的淘汰策略，清理无用: Memory usage is too high: consider scaling up or setting maxmemory with a suitable eviction policy, clean up unused keys / expired data, and look for big keys.
单节点没有高可用：重要数据建议配置从库并启用哨兵 / 集群，至少保证持久化开启。: A single node has no high availability: for important data, configure replicas and enable Sentinel / Cluster, and at least make sure persistence is enabled.
历史内存峰值已接近上限：说明曾出现过内存压力，评估扩容或调整淘汰策略。: Historical peak memory is close to the limit: memory pressure has occurred before; consider scaling up or adjusting the eviction policy.
命中率偏低：检查缓存 key 的过期时间是否过短、是否被淘汰、是否有大量穿透查询: Hit ratio is too low: check whether the expiry times of cache keys are too short, whether keys are being evicted, and whether there are many cache-penetration queries; add memory or warm up the cache if necessary.
复制延迟偏大：检查主库写入量和从库负载，网络带宽，以及是否有大 key / 慢命: Replication lag is too high: check the primary's write volume, the replica's load and the network bandwidth, and whether big keys / slow commands are blocking replay on the replica.
存在大 key：拆分为多个小 key（按范围 / hash 分片），避免对大 k: Big keys exist: split them into multiple smaller keys (by range / hash sharding), avoid running O(N) commands on big keys, and use UNLINK to delete big keys.
存在慢命令：到“SQL 优化 › 慢查日志”查看 Redis 慢查询，避免 KE: Slow commands exist: check Redis slow queries under "SQL optimization › Slow query log", avoid running O(N) commands such as KEYS / HGETALL / SMEMBERS on big keys, and use SCAN / HSCAN or split the key instead.
实例刚启动或正在加载数据：确认重启原因（OOM 被杀 / 人为重启），并检查持久: The instance has just started or is loading data: confirm the reason for the restart (killed by OOM / manual restart), and check that the persistence files are intact and that replication has resynchronized.
实例没有设置访问密码：任何能连到端口的人都可读写全部数据；设置 requirep: The instance has no access password: anyone who can reach the port can read and write all data; set requirepass (or an ACL user) and restrict network access.
实例监听了所有网卡且关闭了 protected-mode：只绑定内网地址，保持: The instance listens on all network interfaces and protected-mode is off: bind only to internal addresses, keep protected-mode yes, and restrict sources with a firewall / security group.
巡检结果无法序列化：%v: Failed to serialize the inspection result: %v
已有 key 因内存不足被淘汰：评估扩容，或确认缓存策略是否符合预期；非缓存实例: Keys have been evicted because of insufficient memory: consider scaling up, or confirm that the caching strategy is as expected; eviction on a non-cache instance should be dealt with as soon as possible.

必须设置 requirepass 或 ACL: requirepass or ACL must be set

有连接被拒绝（达到 maxclients）：检查连接泄漏，调大 maxclien: Connections were rejected (maxclients reached): check for connection leaks, raise maxclients, or use a connection pool / proxy to reduce the number of connections.
未做大 key 抽样：低峰期可在“立即巡检”里勾选“大 key 抽样”（限量，默: Big keys were not sampled: during off-peak hours, tick "Big key sampling" in "Run inspection now" (limited; default 1000 keys).
未开启（默认关闭；立即巡检时可勾选，或设置环境变量 REDIS_INSPECT_: Not enabled (off by default; tick it when running "Run inspection now", or set the environment variable REDIS_INSPECT_BIGKEY_SAMPLE)
未设置 maxmemory：数据增长会一直占用主机内存，直到被系统 OOM 杀掉: maxmemory is not set: data growth will keep consuming host memory until the process is killed by the system OOM killer; set it according to host memory (recommended: 60%~70%) and reserve room for fork and replication buffers.
未采集（INFO 与 CONFIG GET 都读不到）: Not collected (unavailable from both INFO and CONFIG GET)
未采集（INFO 里没有 master_last_io_seconds_ago）: Not collected (master_last_io_seconds_ago is missing from INFO)
未采集（INFO 里没有 rdb_last_bgsave_status）: Not collected (rdb_last_bgsave_status is missing from INFO)
未采集（INFO 里没有 used_memory）: Not collected (used_memory is missing from INFO)
没有开启任何持久化：实例重启后数据全部丢失；纯缓存可忽略，否则开启 AOF（ap: No persistence is enabled: all data is lost when the instance restarts; this can be ignored for a pure cache, otherwise enable AOF (appendonly yes) or configure RDB (save).
监听所有网卡时应开启 protected-mode: protected-mode should be on when listening on all network interfaces
碎片率过高：开启 activedefrag yes（Redis 4.0+），或在: Fragmentation ratio is too high: enable activedefrag yes (Redis 4.0+), or release memory by restarting / failing over during off-peak hours; a ratio below 1 means memory is being swapped, so you must add memory.
设置 maxmemory 时不应为 noeviction（缓存场景）: Should not be noeviction when maxmemory is set (cache scenarios)
请求数 %d 太少，不评估: Only %d requests, too few to evaluate
距上次与主库通信 %d 秒: %d s since last communication with the primary
连接数接近 maxclients：检查业务连接池配置是否泄漏，必要时调大 max: Connections are close to maxclients: check whether the application connection pools are misconfigured or leaking, and raise maxclients if necessary (also mind the system file descriptor limit).
键数量与过期键占比: Key count and share of keys with expiry
阻塞中的客户端较多（BLPOP / BRPOP / WAIT 等）：确认是否是预: Many clients are blocked (BLPOP / BRPOP / WAIT, etc.): confirm they are the expected consumers; an abnormal pile-up means the producers have stopped or the consumer logic is stuck.
